title: AECS Dark Mode
description: A dark-themed resource pack for AE2 Crystal Science
body:
A dark-themed resource pack for [AE2 Crystal Science](https://modrinth.com/mod/ae2-crystal-science).

Designed to be used together with [AE2 Dark Mode](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/ae2-dark-mode) for a consistent visual style.
